For claims that qualify, the Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment will be calculated as: Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment = [Claim Cost – Outlier Threshold] * DRG Marginal Cost Percentage. When Eligible Charges multiplied by the Facility specific CCR ("Claim Cost") for an AHCCCS APR DRG exceed the inpatient Cost Outlier Threshold, which is the sum of the facility specific AHCCCS APR DRG base rate plus the AHCCCS Fixed Loss Amount ("Outlier Threshold") as defined by AHCCCS at the date of discharge, Facility will receive the contract rate as described in Section 2.2 plus the Inpatient Outlier. The Inpatient Outlier is calculated by multiplying the Marginal Cost Percentage as determined and defined by AHCCCS, by the difference of the Claim Cost and the Outlier Threshold, as defined by AHCCCS. That product is multiplied by the AHCCCS Transition Multiplier, as determined by AHCCCS and the Covered Day Adjustment Factor, as applicable. The final product is multiplied by the AHCCCS APR DRG negotiated percentage as indicated in Table 1.
